name: Anime school
description: A sunlit high school in cherry-blossom season: navy and cream, and a spiral notebook for every conversation.

text.headquarters-empty: The classroom is empty: no coordinator is running.
text.register-greeting: {here} asleep here{upstairs}. Who shall I wake, dear?
text.register-empty: Every futon is folded away: nobody is sleeping tonight.
text.letter-for-sleeper: {name} is asleep in the dormitory: the letter waits until it wakes.
text.rookery-empty: Nothing has been posted today. Shall I post one for you?
text.end-session-after: Its pane closes and it goes to the dormitory to sleep; you can wake it there.
text.session-ended: {name}'s session ended; it goes to the dormitory to sleep.
text.conversation-asleep: {name} is asleep in the dormitory. Wake it to talk; it opens in a new terminal window.
text.quest-greeting: {count} requests are addressed to you! Pick one, or look through the whole file.
text.quest-greeting-one: One request is addressed to you! Or look through the whole file.
text.quest-empty: No requests for you today. The council file has all the others.
text.quest-signed-out: I can't open the council files without your Atlassian sign-in. You can add it in Settings!
text.quest-search: Search every request by words or key
text.library-greeting: Welcome to the library! What would you like to look up?
text.library-signed-out: Please sign in to Atlassian in Settings first, then I can find any page for you.
text.library-recent-empty: Pages you read here are noted on your library card.
text.crier-greeting: This is the broadcast club! {count} channels have news. Tell me any channel and I'll read it out!
text.crier-quiet: No news right now! Tell me any channel and I'll read it out.
text.crier-signed-out: The broadcast room isn't tuned in to Slack yet. Sign in and I can read out any channel!
text.forge-greeting: All of these are yours or your classmates'! Which one shall we look at?
text.forge-empty: The benches are empty: nothing of yours or your classmates' is open on GitHub.
text.forge-loading: Let's see what's on the benches…
text.recruit-worker-greeting: A new classmate? Write their name, which club room they'll work in, and their first assignment!
text.recruit-independent-greeting: Inviting a transfer student? Write their name, where they'll work, and what to do first! They don't belong to any class.

pet.name: Calico cat
pet.examine: {name}, the dormitory's calico. Officially a club member.

shiba.name: Shiba
shiba.examine: {name}, the courtyard shiba. Waits by the gate for whoever has snacks.

rabbit-white.name: White rabbit
rabbit-white.examine: {name}, the library's rabbit, napping on the quietest shelf.

crow.name: Crow
crow.examine: {name}, a crow who delivers nothing but takes an interest in every parcel.

tanuki.name: Tanuki
tanuki.examine: {name}, a tanuki who wandered in from the hill and was given a workshop apron.

bell.name: School bell
bell.examine: A brass bell on a wooden frame, with a red tassel.

light.name: Paper lantern
light.examine: A paper lantern painted with cherry blossoms.

box.name: Bento box
box.examine: A wooden bento tied with a blossom band. Not yours. Probably.

candle.name: Desk lamp
candle.examine: A green banker's lamp, glowing softly.

tome.name: Notebook
tome.examine: Someone's class notebook, full of doodles in the margins.
lines: "Club meeting after school! Bring snacks!!"
"A doodle of the calico, labelled: Club President."
"Homework: page 42. (Do it on the train.)"
"Festival ideas: takoyaki stand? Haunted house?"
"Senpai said the build is green! ✨"

spin.name: Goldfish bowl
spin.examine: A round goldfish bowl on a little stand. The goldfish is called Kingyo.

monitor.name: Kanade the hall monitor
monitor.examine: The hall monitor, armband on, clipboard ready, glasses gleaming.
lines: No running in the courtyard! ...You were walking? Then keep walking. Properly.
I have a clipboard, and I'm not afraid to use it.
Tie straight, shoes tied, homework done. Two out of three is a start.
The rules keep everyone safe. Also, I wrote half of them.
If you see the senpai with the guitar, the music room is not a nap room. Tell him.
reactions: That's three times! That's a warning! A friendly one, but a warning!
Please queue properly, even if it's just you.

senpai.name: Haruto-senpai
senpai.examine: A third-year with a guitar case and the calm of someone who never does the reading.
lines: Oh, a new face. Want to join the light music club? We have snacks. Mostly snacks.
They say practise every day. I practise looking cool every day. It's going well.
The secret to a great solo is confidence. And knowing three chords really well.
Don't worry about the festival. It always works out. Usually at the last minute.
You're doing great, kouhai. I can tell. Senpai senses.
reactions: Whoa, so eager! I like it. The sign-up sheet's in the club room.
Easy, easy. Cool people pace themselves.

lunchlady.name: Mrs. Tanaka
lunchlady.examine: The lunch lady, ladle in hand, who knows every student's favourite dish.
lines: Eat your vegetables! Growing minds need carrots. That's science.
Curry day is Friday. I don't make the rules. Well, I do. Curry day is Friday.
You look tired, dear. Have a rice ball. No, take two.
I've fed three generations of this school. The secret ingredient is remembering names.
Midnight snacks are against dorm rules. ...The good ones are on the left shelf.
reactions: Seconds already? Well, you're still growing!
One at a time, one at a time! A ladle only goes so fast.

gardener.name: Mr. Mori the gardener
gardener.examine: The school's gardener, with a watering can and forty springs behind him.
lines: The cherry trees bloom whether anyone watches or not. I like to watch anyway.
Weeds are only flowers nobody asked for. Be kind to them anyway.
Water at dawn, talk to them at noon, apologise at dusk if you stepped on one.
Forty years I've tended this courtyard. The trees and I are old friends.
Slow down, young one. Even bamboo takes its time to start.
reactions: Ho ho, so much energy! Save some for the sports festival.
barks: Who's been stepping on my moss?
